### Jesus Sends out the Twelve
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jesus-sends-out-twelve
Passage: Mark 6:7-13
Points:
- Jesus multiplied His outreach across Galilee by sending the Twelve with divine authority to preach and heal.
- The disciples were instructed to travel light and rely on the hospitality provided in each community.
- Shaking the dust from their feet served as a visible sign of judgment against towns that refused the gospel.
- Warning people about divine accountability reminds hearers of the truth and can ultimately lead to repentance.

### Day 101: Matthew 10:5–10
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-101-matthew-10-510.html
Passage: Matthew 10:8
Points:
- The disciples transitioned from being spectators of Christ's miracles to empowered participants in His mission.
- Walking closely with the incarnate Son of God was already a privilege of immense grace.
- The command to give freely points back to the unreasonable, unearned gifts God has bestowed on us.
- Experiencing God's generous grace should compel believers to pour out their lives in service to others.
